submission.reason: Exploration of data/explore.csv showed anneal_temp was the only candidate with a significant association with tensile_mpa after adjusting for lab (single-exposure OLS: coef +0.36, p=0.008; full model with all ten candidates: coef +0.32, p=0.02), while all other candidates had p>0.10. The pre-registered confirmatory OLS on held-out data (outcome on anneal_temp plus lab indicators) confirmed a positive direct effect: estimate 0.688, SE 0.132, p=2.8e-7, n=396, significant at alpha=0.05.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['anneal_temp','cool_rate','carbon_pct','chromium_pct','grain_size','humidity','press_time','nickel_pct','porosity','cure_hours']
d = df.dropna(subset=['tensile_mpa']).copy()
# full model with all candidates + lab
X = pd.get_dummies(d[['lab']], drop_first=True).astype(float)

X = sm.add_constant(X)
y = d['tensile_mpa'].reset_index(drop=True)
m = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()
print("full model anneal_temp:", round(m.params['anneal_temp'],4), round(m.pvalues['anneal_temp'],4))

# robust (HC3) for single-exposure model
d2 = df.dropna(subset=['anneal_temp','tensile_mpa']).copy()
X2 = pd.get_dummies(d2[['lab']], drop_first=True).astype(float)
X2 = pd.concat([d2[['anneal_temp']].reset_index(drop=True), X2.reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1)
